name: frostbyte
description: Keep Frostbyte up to date as you build. Tasks, board, areas and releases in your agent.

interface.longDescription: Keep Frostbyte up to date as you build. Read and update tasks and the board, organise areas, plan releases and draft release notes. Choose your own work; the agent tracks agreed implementation and checks completion. User Signals are also supported. Works on every Frostbyte plan, Free included. Paid plans are purchased on the Frostbyte website; no purchases or payments are initiated in the agent.
